title: Logo Proportions
slide_intent: Use a controlled comparison to judge when a mark draws attention away from an intentionally oversized headline.
strategic_value: Keeping the signature secondary can preserve the rhythm of a short, expressive line while still identifying its source.
demonstration: Two copies of a food banner retain the same photo and the same two-line headline. The upper example uses the smaller logo and a check. The lower one enlarges it to half headline height and receives a cross.
practical_value: For a composition dominated by very large type, trial the one-third ratio and compare both lockups at the intended viewing size.

content_islands.name: Guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the one-third height rule in the left rail.

content_islands.name: Banner pair
content_islands.spec: Stack the two cream-and-orange advertisements. Keep the headline and photo fixed, change the signature at lower left, and attach the pass or fail caption directly above each banner.
